name: Love And Compassion
overview: Scripture reveals that true love and compassion are deeply rooted in a reverent relationship with God, characterized by hating evil and embracing uprightness, as seen in Psalms and Proverbs. God's love is supremely demonstrated in the giving of His Son for the salvation of the world, calling believers to love one another with the same selfless devotion. This love is sincere and active, rejecting evil and clinging to what is good, reflecting the heart of Christ and the transformative power of the gospel.
